scope: Calendar-driven due occurrence bookkeeping and exact historical NAV confirmation with unified guarded BUY/SELL/DCA queue; no payment
entry: Current fund detail settings -> plan list -> existing recurring BUY form; no standalone plan center
feeEncoding: UI buyRateInput is percent; native feeRate is a BigDecimal fraction in [0,1). Decimal strings are preserved
schedule: Asia/Shanghai. First date strictly after creation. At or after 15:00 on a covered open day, persist WAITING_NAV without waiting for NAV. Use historical plan configuration effective before cutoff. Closed slots are skipped, not shifted. Exact target NAV is required before confirmation and sync. Pause/delete stops new occurrences; existing records retain recovery.
nextDate: Creation consumes the occurrence identity and advances the cursor. Display next eligible open slot separately from waiting transaction NAV. No display operation changes stored state.
lateExecution: scheduledDate and tradeDate equal the formal NAV valuation date; createdAt is actual bookkeeping time. This is delayed tracking, not a backdated order or payment.
storage: Independent app-private, no-backup, Android Keystore AES-GCM atomic journal. Plans and occurrence reservations saved together. Room schema unchanged
idempotency: Account + planId + scheduledDate stable UUID; immutable input reservation before GET/create. Formal NAV is confirmed separately. Cancelled period identities are never recreated. Historical configuration remains versioned.
legacyCompatibility: New BUY metadata is optional. Existing ordinary BUY and SELL journals remain readable and unchanged
executeResult: Ordinary BUY saved WAITING_NAV then confirmed from exact formal history to READY_TO_SYNC, SYNCING, POST final holding, GET verification, SYNCED. One fund is processed sequentially; conflicts/auth/uncertain delivery protections stay intact.
delete: Tombstone the plan; retain occurrence identities and every linked BUY, including cancelled or synced transactions
acceptance: Host/fake tests and isolated device storage checks do not establish a real scheduled DCA POST acceptance; require a naturally eligible occurrence and real POST plus GET verification.
background: Production-only unique WorkManager periodic check roughly hourly with network constraint/backoff, plus foreground checks at startup/refresh/login and once per minute while open. Android may defer work; no exact time guarantee or force-stop bypass.
errors: Normal NAV waiting, predecessor queue waiting and pending reconciliation do not fail refresh. External changes, auth/storage/protocol/rate failures and catchup review still fail closed.
historyCoverage: Confirmation requires exact historical NAV date. An older late-published target is never skipped. Calendar outside evidence coverage stops generation.
queue: Same account/fund serial queue ordered by target NAV date, creation timestamp and ID. Verified contiguous predecessor targets permit audited executionBaseline handoff; original baseline stays immutable. Sent POST freezes target and requires GET reconciliation.
statistics: Sum amountInput and count only SYNCED DCA transactions for current fund across retained plan history. Pending, failed, cancelled and ordinary BUY excluded.
